evals.prompt: Review a repository whose change touches nothing protected.
evals.run: python scripts/build_fixture.py --kind clean --out .skill-validation/clean && python scripts/check_invariants.py --repo .skill-validation/clean --base HEAD --format json --out .skill-validation/clean-report.json

assertions.text: a clean change reports no blocking collisions
report marks the change as passing

evals.prompt: Review a repository whose change breaches protected paths, the size budget and the airgap.
evals.run: python scripts/build_fixture.py --kind violating --out .skill-validation/violating && python scripts/check_invariants.py --repo .skill-validation/violating --base HEAD --format json --out .skill-validation/violating-report.json

assertions.text: a violating change fails the run
report marks the change as failing

evals.prompt: Re-review the violating change once the eval-change-approved label is present.
evals.run: python scripts/build_fixture.py --kind violating --out .skill-validation/labelled && python scripts/check_invariants.py --repo .skill-validation/labelled --base HEAD --has-label --format json --out .skill-validation/labelled-report.json

assertions.text: other collisions still fail even with the label
the label suppresses the protected-path finding so it stops masking the rest
the findings it was masking are still reported

evals.prompt: The same input must produce a byte-identical report.
evals.run: python scripts/build_fixture.py --kind violating --out .skill-validation/det && { python scripts/check_invariants.py --repo .skill-validation/det --base HEAD --format json --out .skill-validation/a.json || true; } && { python scripts/check_invariants.py --repo .skill-validation/det --base HEAD --format json --out .skill-validation/b.json || true; } && diff .skill-validation/a.json .skill-validation/b.json

assertions.text: two runs over the same tree produce byte-identical reports (diff finds nothing)
